judge.rationale: The candidate accurately implements token usage accumulation across tool rounds in `chatOrchestrator.ts`, handling partial or missing usage reports without introducing `NaN` or erasing existing counts. It satisfies every acceptance criterion in the issue, including leaving the existing no-tool test untouched, clarifying the hook signature (`totalUsage?: TurnUsageMetadata`), and updating both `CHANGELOG.md` and `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`. Compared to the reference, the candidate introduces a `TurnUsageMetadata` type alias exported from `src/index.ts` and adds two separate test files (`chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts` and `chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts`) rather than adding tests directly to `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`. In `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate also left the new `afterModelResponse` bullets under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' heading rather than moving the spec assertion into the main hooks section as the reference did. Despite these minor organizational differences, the core implementation and behavior match the reference and ticket requirements.
